A '''Point-to-pint encryption device''', sometimes abbreviated as '''PTP encryption device''', was a device that could be used to encrypt [[PTP link]]s. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were considered archaic.<ref name="Strongholds" />
